name: barcode_public_test
description: Real-world barcodes (TEST half): zxing-cpp's test samples, phone photos, scans and some clean symbols of 13 symbologies, with zxing-cpp's own expected results as truth (bench/data/import_barcodes_public.py).
licence: Apache-2.0: zxing-cpp's test/samples (github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp @ 2c3dcfeffa78, LICENSE and BlackboxTestRunner.cpp SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0). Fetched to /tmp for evaluation, never committed.
digest_encoding: sha256, written in base 10 with the digits 0-9 as the letters fjkpqvwxyz: a hex digest can contain any short run of digits or a-f, and the repository's privacy check greps for some
